collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A child has found a better way to catch crabs that the adults ignored: let the child show everyone, or test it first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has discovered that crabs will crawl into a hollow coconut shell left in the shallows overnight, and has caught twenty in a week this way. (friend) and the other crab-catchers have been laughing at the coconut shells. What should happen?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) gives a demonstration on the beach. In the morning, every shell has a crab in it. The crab-catchers stop laughing. (subject) is invited to teach, and takes it very seriously.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) tests it quietly for a week. It works. (friend) tells everyone it was (subject)'s idea, loudly, so nobody can think otherwise. (subject) is very pleased.
